objective: Enforce rigorous distinction between pointwise observation error comparison and nonlinear aggregate metric comparison across model benchmarks.

forecast_pointwise.description: Individual flight operational prediction. Paired difference d_i = |e_A_i| - |e_B_i| is algebraically well-defined at the observation level.

aggregate_forecast.description: Entire evaluation population / fold. Nonlinear aggregate metrics (RMSE, R^2, PR-AUC, coverage error) are ratios/integrals that CANNOT be decomposed into additive observation-level deltas. Requires paired aggregate bootstrap.

downstream.description: Downstream optimization evaluation under matched synthetic arrival scenarios, gates, and objective seeds.

monte_carlo.description: Monte Carlo outer simulation replication. Individual draws within scenario are NOT independent experiments.

rmse.semantic_restriction: Strictly prohibits rowwise subtraction (which yields Delta_MSE, not Delta_RMSE). Requires paired aggregate bootstrap.

r2.semantic_restriction: Strictly prohibits rowwise pseudo-observation formulas (1 - se_i * n / SS_tot). Requires paired aggregate bootstrap.

pr_auc.semantic_restriction: Rank-based non-linear curve integration. Fails closed to NOT_AVAILABLE if single class.

dependence_handling.rationale: Flight delays exhibit temporal clustering, shared airspace congestion waves, and airport-wide weather shocks. Resampling schemes must be pre-registered without cherry-picking block lengths post-hoc.

iid_percentile.description: Standard uniform resampling with replacement across individual flights.

day_cluster_percentile.description: Cluster bootstrap resampling unique operational dates with replacement, retaining all flights within resampled days.
day_cluster_percentile.why_this_unit: Accounts for intra-day temporal correlation, shared ATC congestion waves, and airport-wide weather shocks across flights.

fixed_block_percentile.description: Resamples contiguous blocks of fixed integer length L with replacement.

stationary_block_percentile.description: Politis & Romano (1994) stationary bootstrap with geometrically distributed block lengths having mean L and circular index wrap-around.
stationary_block_percentile.why_this_unit: Guarantees stationary bootstrap distribution while capturing serial autocorrelation.

multiplicity_correction.rationale: Holm-Bonferroni step-down procedure controls Family-Wise Error Rate (FWER) under arbitrary dependence without over-conservatism of single-step Bonferroni.

family_definitions.point_regression: 10 pairs per fold (5 core models: Linear, RF, HGB, XGB, Ensemble)
family_definitions.probabilistic: 10 pairs per fold (5 probabilistic candidates: P1 - P5)
